facts.value: The Unibator serves as an 'incubator for innovation' at Goethe University. It supports students, staff, and alumni from all departments in transforming scientific insights and resulting business ideas into market-ready products and services.
The AndersGründer project at the Social Impact Lab Frankfurt supports startups in founding their social enterprise, providing coaching, qualification, co-working, and access to relevant networks.

The universities in the FrankfurtRheinMain knowledge region are coming together to consolidate their competencies in supporting startup initiatives from the academic environment in a central internet portal.
